correctness.rationale: For n>=13, direct character formulas reduce Haar sixth moments to zero-frequency Laurent coefficient since |F|^6 has frequencies [-12,12]. Six-step sign counts give the exact moments (10,0,7,0,6,0,10) in rotation-probability-half normalization. Expansion of |aX+bY|² and the zero odd moments gives polynomial 10(p³+q³)+21p²q+18pq²+(84p+72q)Re(a conjugate b)². Its aligned-phase one-variable quotient is P(x)=-15x³-45x²+60x+10. The unique maximizer x*=-1+sqrt(21)/3 yields K=-80+70sqrt(21)/3 and the exact positive factorization. Positive Laurent coefficients prove strict enhancement for every 5<=n<=12. The accompanying code passed 5750 assertions in a fresh local run, including direct finite-group quadrature; all-order statements rely on the analytic calculations.

value.rationale: The first adjacent pair of nontrivial two-dimensional irreducibles on dihedral groups is a natural noncommutative Fourier synthesis packet. Across all finite orders n>=13 it has the exact sharp sixth moment, an unequal and phase-locked complete complex optimizer, and a globally exact positive stability deficit. The threshold is proved optimal using all exceptional orders, separating finite-frequency aliasing from stable harmonic behavior. The invariant has an explicit representation-theoretic motivation, is not a known-table recomputation in the sources inspected, and is not supported solely by numerical work.
